EquipmentInfoDto.title: EquipmentInfo

equipmentId.description:
The system ID of equipment in Onix Work
This field can be used to identify updating equipment in Onix Work and has top priority for identifier

globalId.description:
Used as a globally unique identifier for equipment.
Accepted format: GUID format or Hex Digits format with 5 characters as minimum
This field is used to identify updating equipment in Onix Work and has higher priority than importId
Default-value: 24 Hex digits code will be generated from Onix Work
When create new equipment and submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be generated as "Default-value"
This field cannot be updated

importId.description:
ImportID from the exporting service.
This field can be used to identify updating equipment in Onix Work and has lower priority than equipmentId and globalId
Default-value: Null
When creating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"
When updating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be unchanged

serialNumber.description:
Serial number of equipment. (one of serial number, batch number or Owner's ID must be filled in)
Default-value: Null
When creating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"
When updating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be unchanged

batchNo.description:
Batch number of equipment. (one of serial number, batch number or Owner's ID must be filled in)
Default-value: Null
When creating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"
When updating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be unchanged

ownerEquipmentId.description:
Owner's ID of equipment. (one of serial number, batch number or Owner's ID must be filled in)
Default-value: Null
When creating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"
When updating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be unchanged

companySupplier.description:
The supplier of equipment in Onix Work.
Values can get from api `GET /company`.
Default-value: ID of your company in Onix Work
When create new equipment and submitted value is null or 0, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"
This field cannot be updated

producer.description:
Producer of equipment (optional).
Default-value: Null
When creating equipment and the submitted value is null, data in Onix Work will be created as "Default-value"

OnixToken.description:
The token can be obtained as below:

1)Issue long-lived token
+ Access Onix Work to issue the token under Setting page.
+ Add Authorization header to every request with value: 'Key' [space] [token]

2)Issue short-lived token
+ Make a call to `POST /account/token` with username and password from your account in Onix Work.
+ Add Authorization header to every request with value: 'Bearer' [space] [token]

Otherwise contact Onix by sending email to support@onix.com for further help.
Attach the obtained token when make request, or you can try it out by entering it in the text input below:
OnixToken.name: Authorization
